audit.why: Darius owning levels 1-2 and 4-5 with skill windows at 3 and 6 matches the kits: Apprehend at 535 range drags Trundle inside Decimate before Chomp has banked any AD, and the lane only turns once Pillar of Ice can answer a champion whose sole gap-closer is on a 26s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level-6 spike claims Subjugate makes 'his Noxian Guillotine execute threshold nearly impossible to reach' by stripping his armour. Guillotine deals true damage — stolen armour does nothing to it.
audit.why: Riot's Noxian Guillotine text: 'leaps to an enemy champion and strikes a lethal blow, dealing true damage. This damage is increased for each stack of Hemorrhage on the target.' The interaction file flags Darius under 'bypasses stacking resistances (Noxian Guillotine)'. What actually moves the threshold is the percent of HEALTH Subjugate takes off him and gives you, plus denying the fifth Hemorrhage stack.
audit.corrected: Spike, mid and whys[4] now say the armour is irrelevant to R and name the two things that do move the threshold.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three problems. (a) 'Apprehend (Pull)' is used as the ability name across the full layer and breakdown.cooldowns lists the same spell twice under both labels. (b) The armour-versus-Guillotine error above, repeated in spikes[1], mid and whys[4]. (c) The single best positional counter in this matchup is never stated: only the outer blade of Decimate heals Darius, so standing inside the handle costs him both the bonus damage and the heal — and Trundle's 300-range Chomp puts him there naturally.
audit.why: Riot's Decimate text: 'Enemies struck by the blade take more damage than those struck by the handle. Darius heals based on enemy champions and large monsters hit by the blade.' Riot's Apprehend text also carries a passive: 'passively causing his physical damage to ignore a percentage of his target's Armor', which is worth knowing before you build armour or steal his. Chomp saps Attack Damage, which shrinks Decimate and every Hemorrhage tick at the same time.
audit.corrected: Name and duplicate cooldown line fixed, the true-damage correction applied in all three places, and the blade-versus-handle rule plus the AD-sap-shrinks-bleed point written in.

audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend is the tracked ability on a dozen lines and its duration is never given, which hides the biggest window in the lane.
audit.why: Apprehend is 26/23.5/21/18.5/16 — twenty-six seconds at rank 1, by far the longest cooldown either champion has early. Decimate is 9s, Crippling Strike 5s, Noxian Guillotine 120/100/80 and it refreshes on a kill.
audit.corrected: 26s now carried in the ability label itself, plus the cooldown block, the dos and the report.

edits.before: At levels 1 and 2 you are playing against one of the strongest early bullies in the game — Darius's E-pull brings you directly into his bleed range, and a single empowered Q healing auto while Hemorrhage ticks makes him impossible to out-trade straight. Do not step into his E range without a clear answer. Instead auto-space just outside his pull distance and use Q Chomp on the rare occasions he overextends, banking the Attack Damage steal before he can activate the bleed cycle. If he lands the E, immediately drop Frozen Domain underneath yourself — the movement speed lets you walk out of his follow-up Q range before the fifth stack of Hemorrhage applies, and King's Tribute healing from dying minions starts recovering the chip damage before you hit tower.
edits.after: At levels 1 and 2 you are playing against one of the strongest early bullies in the game — Darius's E-pull brings you directly into his bleed range, and Decimate over a ticking Hemorrhage makes him impossible to out-trade straight. Do not step into his E range without a clear answer. Instead auto-space just outside his pull distance and use Q Chomp on the rare occasions he overextends, banking the Attack Damage steal that shrinks his Decimate and every bleed tick at once. If he does land the E, stand right on top of him: only the outer blade of Decimate heals him, so the handle costs him the bonus damage and the heal together. Then drop Frozen Domain underneath yourself and walk out before the fifth Hemorrhage stack lands, with King's Tribute recovering the chip off dying minions.

edits.before: At level 3 he still owns the short trade because Hemorrhage fully stacks in under two seconds, but you start getting genuine tools — Pillar behind him the moment he commits his E-pull, cutting off his walk-back, then drop Frozen Domain and start chewing through his armor with repeated Chomps. He cannot disengage without walking through the pillar slow. The actual lane flip arrives at level 6: the moment Subjugate lands on a Darius who has been stacking armor, you borrow a percentage of that very armor mid-fight. His Noxian Guillotine execute threshold becomes nearly impossible to reach because your effective HP inflates while his damage source — raw Armor-against-AD — shrinks. Look to all-in the moment his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: At level 3 he still owns the short trade because Hemorrhage fully stacks in under two seconds, but you start getting genuine tools — Pillar behind him the moment he commits his E-pull, cutting off his walk-back, then drop Frozen Domain and start chewing through his armor with repeated Chomps. He cannot disengage without walking through the pillar slow. The actual lane flip arrives at level 6: Subjugate takes a percent of his Health, Armor and MR and hands it to you. Noxian Guillotine is true damage, so the armour changes nothing there — what moves his execute threshold is the health swing and denying him the fifth Hemorrhage stack that inflates the damage. Look to all-in the moment his E is on cooldown.

notes: Biggest fix: the page told the player three times that stealing Darius's armour makes Noxian Guillotine 'nearly impossible' to land. Guillotine is true damage — Riot's own text — and the interaction file already flags Darius under resistances-invalidated. Corrected in spikes[1], mid and whys[4], with the two things that DO move the threshold named instead (the percent of Health Subjugate takes, and denying the fifth Hemorrhage stack). Second: 'Apprehend (Pull)' was being used as the name and breakdown.cooldowns listed the same spell twice; now 'Apprehend (26s)', which also fixes the missing cooldown — 26s at rank 1 is the largest window in the lane and was never stated. Third and newly added: only the outer blade of Decimate heals him, so a 300-range Chomp naturally puts you in the handle where he gets neither the bonus damage nor the heal. packets/trundle.json gives 51.91 (418 games) while MC_WR_TABLES.trundle.darius is 45.48 — a 6.4-point gap on the largest sample in the slice; MC_WR_TABLES is not writable so no edit proposed, but the two disagree badly and this matchup's diff/diffRating pair ('HARD' vs 4/10) disagree too.
